heroParagraphs: Most data platforms function as expensive digital filing cabinets. They are built to treat data as numbers trapped in a cell—passively capturing payments, work orders, and lease details.
We model reality. By combining deep domain and data expertise specific to corporate real estate, we map the context and the relationships between every lease, space, person, project, and dollar.

We’ve spent a combined 30+ years at JLL managing Fortune 500 real estate portfolios and data initiatives. We’ve seen firsthand where the gaps exist and what it actually takes to close them. We built C&D to turn those hard-won corporate lessons into an agile playbook—so you can move fast while avoiding the pitfalls and multi-million dollar mistakes.

cta.title: Book a Portfolio Audit
cta.body: You are likely sitting on a goldmine of data trapped inside static, siloed systems. In 45 minutes, we will identify the bottlenecks keeping your team stuck in the past.
bullets: AI Readiness: A clear assessment of how prepared your architecture is for the next wave of automation.
The Integrity Gap: Pinpoint exactly which data sources are undermining your high-stakes decisions.
The CDM Shortcut: Discover how our Common Data Model bypasses the 24 months needed for data projects.
The ROI Roadmap: A prioritized list of optimization tasks that lead to immediate cost reduction and time savings.
